abilities.description: After assigning all your starting stats, add +1 to Edge. Always take +1 to survival and tracking rolls, and +1 again while doing it at night, and +1 again if it is in a jungle-like environment. Always add +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.2051538f0c9d5d27]{Heal} if you use medicinal plants or other natural healing agents/mixtures that you take from a wild environment, and add +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.13b2d777c6fb719d]{Gather Information} to find those natural medicines. You may start the game with either the Hunter or the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.6e439be2dd0bd5a4]{Brawler} asset (you still get your usual starting assets).
